text:
Sam: Postmortem up for IO eviction. Need to convert remediation items into tests and owners. link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/io-cache-2026

Marta: I can build the regression harness (replay + pressure toggle). Target: branch CI + nightly. ETA ~10 business days.

Priya: I'll schedule the sustained load (90m ramp) and open a perf ticket. Assigned to me, due 2w.

Kai: I'll extract and sanitize two representative traces and put them in the incident bucket. ETA 48h.

Taylor: I'll own promptsets and evals: short/long context, latency + correctness checks. Acceptance: P95 <= 1.3x, accuracy drop < 1%. ETA 7 days.

Marta: Test naming proposal so it's searchable:
```
tests/evals/eviction/
  - eviction_replay.yaml
  - eviction_sustained_90m.yaml
labels: ["regression","eviction","kv","chaos"]
```

Sam: Chaos plan: tabletop first (30m) then one staging run. Marta lead live run, Kai infra, Taylor evals. I'll schedule tabletop for next Tue 11:00.

Priya: Added PERF-4930 "eviction-90m-load" and linked to the postmortem. ops-bot created CI template `eviction-nightly`.

ops-bot: Ticket PERF-4930 created and CI job `eviction-nightly` queued for 03:00 UTC after PR merge.

Marta: Checklist for PR: 1) harness + tests, 2) sanitized traces, 3) CI job, 4) perf ticket link, 5) acceptance criteria doc. I'll track in PR description.

Sam: Owners recap: Marta (harness & live run), Taylor (promptsets & evals), Priya (load orchestration), Kai (traces & infra), Sam (tabletop + follow-up). Everyone drop EOD ETAs into PR.

Kai: Will post sanitized trace links to PERF-4930 in ~48h.

Marta: Good. Also propose alert rule draft: if eviction rate > 0.5% for 10m AND P99 tail > 2x baseline, auto-open an ops breadcrumbs ticket. I'll add to alerts RFC.

Sam: Thanks — converting thread into follow-up doc and linking to PERF-4930. We'll sync after tabletop. :thumbsup:
